items.title: 卡達居中斡旋跑斷腿但美伊雙方都不讓步　川普恐到選後再算帳？
items.title_en: Qatar’s Mediation Stalls While Both the U.S. and Iran Hold Firm; Trump May Wait Until After Election to Act
paras: 外媒最新報導指出，卡達本週斡旋美伊外交突破幾乎無實質進展，雙方在核問題與海上封鎖等關鍵條件互不退讓，多哈調解人對前景愈發沮喪，美國官員則評估，若僵局延續，美國總統川普可能在11月期中選舉後下令恢復大規模作戰行動。
《Axios》引述三名消息人士報導，卡達調解人阿里·薩瓦迪周一(28日)在紐約與伊朗外長阿拉格齊會談數小時，討論一份兩頁折衷方案：一邊回應伊朗要求解除美國海上封鎖、恢復原油外運，一邊要求德黑蘭在核計畫作具體讓步，同日晚間薩瓦迪轉往華府會見庫許納及美方官員，副總統范斯參與部分會議。對此白宮拒絕置評。
知情人士稱談判實際「卡住」，伊方條件美方難接受，美方自認佔優、不願選前妥協。
巴基斯坦、埃及敦促伊朗在核計畫讓步；伊朗則堅持美方先回到6月諒解備忘錄框架，才考慮進一步讓步。
伊朗最高國安會秘書雷扎伊周二(29日)說，已透過調解管道送達條件，但「川普無力做決定」，並形容川普陷入既不能談、又不能打的泥潭，川普同日則重申不允許伊朗擁核，稱談判目標就是阻止核武器。
卡達外交部發言人安薩里表示，多哈仍雙向傳遞訊息，爭取避免衝突外溢。
能源方面，受荷姆茲海峽不確定性牽動，國際油價周二收跌約2.5%，但中東出口恢復未穩，美國能源部以「互換」釋出戰略儲油(SPR)最多4000萬桶，將在11-12月交付、日後回補，SPR庫存至9月中約2.846億桶，較3月底減逾1.3億桶。
與此同時，美國周二新增制裁10名個人與實體，指其協助伊朗採購武器零部件。外交未突破、軍事選項卻升溫，歐洲與新興經濟體冬季能源成本壓力短期難解。
paras_en: Foreign media reports this week say Qatar’s mediation of a U.S.-Iran diplomatic breakthrough has made virtually no substantive progress. The two sides refuse to budge on key issues such as the nuclear program and a maritime blockade, leaving Doha’s mediator increasingly discouraged. U.S. officials assess that if the deadlock continues, President Trump could order a large‑scale military operation after the November mid‑term elections.

Axios, citing three sources, reported that Qatar’s mediator Ali Al‑Sawadi met with Iranian Foreign Minister Amir Abdollahian in New York on Monday (the 28th) for a few hours. They discussed a two‑page compromise: Iran would see the U.S. lift its maritime blockade and resume crude exports, while Tehran would make concrete concessions on its nuclear program. That evening Sawadi flew to Washington to meet with Secretary of State Antony Blinken and other U.S. officials, with Vice President Kamala Harris attending part of the talks. The White House declined to comment.
Insiders say the negotiations are effectively “stuck”; Iran’s demands are hard for the U.S. to accept, and the U.S. believes it has the upper hand and is unwilling to compromise before the election.

Pakistan and Egypt have urged Iran to make concessions on its nuclear program; Iran, in turn, insists the U.S. must first return to the framework of the June Memorandum of Understanding before it will consider further steps.

Iran’s top national security council secretary, Ali Rezaei, said on Tuesday (the 29th) that Iran had transmitted its conditions through the mediation channel, but “Trump is powerless to decide.” He described Trump as being stuck in a quagmire where he can neither negotiate nor fight. On the same day Trump reiterated that he will not allow Iran to acquire a nuclear weapon, saying the goal of the talks is to prevent a nuclear arsenal.
Qatar’s foreign ministry spokesperson, Abdullah Al‑Ansari, said Doha continues to convey messages both ways in an effort to prevent the conflict from spilling over.

On the energy front, uncertainty in the Hormuz Strait pulled international oil prices down about 2.5% on Tuesday, but Middle‑East exports have not yet stabilized. The U.S. Energy Department announced a “swap” release of up to 40 million barrels from the Strategic Petroleum Reserve, to be delivered in November‑December and later replenished. SPR inventories stood at roughly 284.6 million barrels in mid‑September, down more than 130 million barrels since the end of March.

At the same time, the United States added sanctions on Tuesday against ten individuals and entities for helping Iran procure weapons components. Diplomatic breakthroughs remain elusive while military options heat up, leaving Europe and emerging economies facing short‑term winter energy‑cost pressures that are hard to relieve.

items.title: 聯準會35歷史上從未在選舉前的10月升息！瑞銀：這次可能也一樣
paras: 美伊衝突推升油價之際，美國公債殖利率同步攀升至近20年高點，市場對聯準會（Fed）10月再度升息的押注也升溫。不過，瑞銀（UBS）認為，市場可能嚴重高估聯準會在美國期中選舉前採取行動的可能性。
根據外媒報導，瑞銀分析師Simon Penn在週一（28日）發布的報告指出，市場目前對10月28日聯準會會議升息的機率定價約69%，存在明顯偏差。
Penn表示，儘管聯準會一再強調貨幣政策決策不受政治活動影響，但在重大政治事件前夕保持克制，仍是歷來常見的做法。
因此，他建議交易員降低對10月升息的押注，並將未來1年累計升息幅度的定價，從目前約91個基點降至75個基點。

35年歷史紀錄：聯準會從未在大選前10月升息

Penn回顧自1990年以來的歷史紀錄發現，過去35年間，僅有3次聯準會在接近11月大選的9月會議升息，分別發生於2004年、2018年及2022年；至於10月會議，則從未出現升息。
其中，2022年升息幅度最大，聯準會單次升息75個基點，是現代史上大選前最大的單次升息幅度，當時聯準會正積極應對疫情後的通膨衝擊。
2004年的升息則屬於當年6月開始的漸進式緊縮周期，並持續至整個選舉季；2018年升息則發生在時任總統川普公開施壓要求聯準會暫停升息的背景下。
Penn認為，若剔除10月升息的市場定價，也不代表投資人應重新押注12月大幅升息50個基點。目前市場對12月會議的累計升息定價約38個基點，他認為應回到完整的25個基點。
從交易角度來看，被移除的10月升息定價應分散至後續會議。Penn預估，明年1月及3月會議的定價將分別增加約12個基點及18個基點。
整體而言，他建議交易員做空長天期債券，並將未來1年累計升息定價由91個基點降至75個基點。

美債殖利率飆升　股票估值承受壓力

另一方面，瑞銀市場分析師Nana Antiedu援引美股策略師Keith Parker的觀點指出，美債殖利率近期急遽攀升，已對股票估值造成明顯壓力，但這也代表，若殖利率回落，市場可能出現較大的反彈空間。
Parker指出，自去年11月以來，隨著10年期美債殖利率今年累計上升約100個基點，標普500指數未來12個月本益比已下滑17%，估值壓縮程度接近衰退情境，也可與1994年升息週期相提並論。
歷史經驗顯示，若利率在沒有大幅緊縮的情況下趨於穩定，也就是年內升息幅度低於100個基點，標普500指數隨後一年通常能取得兩位數報酬；但若進入完整升息週期，亦即年內升息超過100個基點，歷史上的股市報酬往往持平甚至轉為負值。
Parker認為，目前股市對殖利率下滑的反應彈性，大於殖利率進一步上升所帶來的下行風險。他建議投資人為利率維持高檔的環境做好布局，同時留意殖利率回落可能帶來的機會。
在產業配置方面，半導體、製藥、煉油及多元化銀行等次產業獲得較高評價，且對利率的敏感度相對較低。

油價與通膨成市場關鍵變數

目前市場面臨的核心矛盾在於美伊衝突推升能源價格，同時推高通膨及利率壓力。布蘭特原油價格已升至每桶106美元，10年期及30年期美債殖利率則分別攀至2007年及2004年以來最高水準。
市場目前關注的問題是，高能源價格是否會使通膨維持黏著，進而迫使聯準會延長緊縮週期。
本週即將公布的一系列美國經濟數據，將進一步檢驗市場對聯準會政策的預期。若經濟成長數據強勁，可能為聯準會提供更多緊縮空間；若通膨數據高於預期，則可能進一步強化升息理由。
高盛另指出，當10年期美債殖利率在兩週內上升約30個基點，或一個月內上升約50個基點時，股市通常會面臨明顯阻力。
目前10年期美債殖利率自9月9日以來已上升28個基點，自8月21日以來則累計上升37個基點，正接近歷史經驗所顯示的關鍵區間。
市場多頭押注殖利率能在借貸成本進一步侵蝕股市之前趨於穩定；若能源價格見頂、地緣衝突出現緩和跡象，股市可能出現反彈。不過，若能源價格持續高檔，同時經濟數據持續支持聯準會維持緊縮政策，市場面臨的壓力也可能進一步升高。

items.title: Fed三把手喊「不急」 美10月升息機率摔回五成
items.title_en: Fed Deputy Says "No Rush", October Rate Hike Odds Slip to About 50%
paras: 市場參與者近期愈來愈相信，美國聯準會(Fed)將在10月會議再次升息，但一名具影響力的聯準會(Fed)官員卻釋出謹慎訊號，暗示市場可能對10月升息押注過頭。
紐約聯準銀行總裁威廉斯(John Williams)周二(29日在紐約州布法羅大學(University of Buffalo)演說時表示，Fed在9月升息後沒有必要急著再次升息，可以先蒐集更多數據，再決定是否進一步調整利率。
威廉斯說：「我們在9月決策會議採取的政策行動，已經沒有急迫性，我們有時間蒐集更多資訊。」他是Fed第三把交椅，每次利率決策都有投票權。
Fed 9月升息1碼，將聯邦基金利率目標區間調升至3.75-4.00%，這是2023年以來首次升息。

10月升息機率從70%降至略高於50%

威廉斯的談話發布後，市場對10月升息的預期明顯降溫。衍生品市場交易員周一曾把10月升息機率推高至70%，周二降至60%，並在W威廉斯演說後，進一步降至略高於50%。
目前交易員預期，Fed接下來到明年3月還會升息三次，每次幅度為1碼(25個基點)。
威廉斯表示，9月升息是為了「讓通膨率更及時回到2%目標」。他指出，雖然貨幣政策無法讓船隻恢復航行，也無法重新開放輸油管線及煉油廠，但可以把供給衝擊擴散並導致通膨更廣泛、更持久的風險給降低。
針對利率展望，威廉斯強調，Fed關注的是經濟的「基本趨勢」。一些認為Fed 10月不會升息的經濟學家指出，威廉斯所說的「趨勢」一詞，可能代表Fed需要觀察的不只是單月數據，而在10月27-28日的決策會議前，Fed能取得的經濟數據相當有限。

威廉斯暗示今年可能只再升息一次

威廉斯進一步暗示，市場可能已經超前Fed，因為Fed今年可能只需要再升息一次，時間可能落在「今年稍晚」。
他說：「如果經濟發展大致符合我的預測，今年稍晚再一次調升聯邦基金利率目標區間，可能是適當的做法，有助於讓通膨更及時回到目標。」
Inflation Insights總裁Omair Sharif分析，Williams的談話與其他Fed官員形成對比，例如Fed理事巴爾(Michael Barr)就曾表示，Fed可能需要多次升息。
巴爾周二在另一場公開活動中表示，較高的關稅及伊朗戰爭「意味著我們朝2%目標邁進的進程已偏離軌道」。
威廉斯則預期，明年通膨率將放緩至略高於Fed 2%目標的水準。
Fed今年還剩兩場決策會議，分別在10月底及12月中旬。根據Fed本月稍早公布的經濟預測顯示，18名官員中有16人預期今年還會再升息一次。

市場利率走高 Fed恐面臨更大壓力

Evercore ISI副董事長Krishna Guha周一指出，債券市場對積極升息的定價，顯示Fed主席華許(Kevin Warsh)及其同僚「有失去市場利率及政策立場控制權的危險」。
華許一直強調不喜歡提供「前瞻指引」(forward guidance)，也就是向市場透露Fed對特定未來會議的政策思考。他的前任鮑爾則經常採取這種做法。
SGH Macro Advisors首席美國經濟學家Tim Duy表示，鮑爾過去通常把前瞻指引當成「鴿派的錨」，也就是向市場說明自己沒有意願升息，「擺脫這個錨之後，在目前環境下，整條殖利率曲線上的利率只剩上升這個方向。」
paras_en: Market participants have become increasingly convinced that the Federal Reserve will raise rates again at its October meeting, but an influential Fed official has signaled caution, suggesting the market may be over‑betting on an October hike.

John Williams, President of the Federal Reserve Bank of New York, said on Tuesday, Oct. 29, during a speech at the University of Buffalo, that after the September rate increase the Fed does not need to rush another hike and can first gather more data before deciding on further adjustments.

Williams said, "The policy action we took at the September decision meeting is no longer urgent; we have time to collect more information." He is the Fed’s third‑ranking official and votes on every rate decision.
The Fed raised rates by one quarter point in September, moving the federal funds target range to 3.75‑4.00%, the first hike since 2023.

October hike odds fell from 70% to just above 50%. After Williams’ remarks, market expectations for an October hike cooled noticeably. Derivatives traders had pushed the odds to 70% on Monday, trimmed them to 60% on Tuesday, and after Williams’ speech lowered them to a little over 50%.
Traders now expect the Fed to raise rates three more times through March next year, each move of one quarter point (25 basis points).

Williams said the September hike was intended to "bring inflation back to the 2% target more promptly." He noted that while monetary policy cannot get ships sailing again or reopen oil pipelines and refineries, it can diffuse supply‑side shocks and reduce the risk of broader, more persistent inflation.

On the rate outlook, Williams emphasized that the Fed is focused on the economy’s "underlying trend." Some economists who think the Fed will not hike in October note that the word "trend" may imply the Fed needs to look beyond a single month’s data, and that the amount of economic data available before the Oct. 27‑28 decision meeting is limited.
Williams hinted the Fed may only raise rates once more this year, possibly later in the year.

He said, "If economic developments roughly match my forecasts, a further adjustment to the federal funds target range later this year could be appropriate and would help bring inflation back to target more promptly."
Inflation Insights President Omair Sharif observed that Williams’ comments contrast with those of other Fed officials, such as Governor Michael Barr, who has said the Fed may need multiple hikes.
Barr said on Tuesday at another public event that higher tariffs and the war in Iran "mean we are off track in our progress toward the 2% target."
Williams expects inflation to ease next year to a level slightly above the Fed’s 2% goal.

The Fed has two policy meetings left this year, at the end of October and mid‑December. According to the Fed’s latest economic projections released earlier this month, 16 of 18 officials anticipate another hike this year.

Rising market rates could put the Fed under greater pressure. Evercore ISI Vice Chairman Krishna Guha noted on Monday that bond‑market pricing of aggressive hikes shows Fed Chair Kevin Warsh and his colleagues "risk losing control over market rates and policy stance."
Warsh has consistently said he dislikes providing forward guidance, i.e., signaling the Fed’s policy thinking for specific future meetings. His predecessor, Jerome Powell, often used that approach.

Tim Duy, Chief U.S. Economist at SGH Macro Advisors, said Powell previously treated forward guidance as a "dove’s anchor," indicating no intent to hike. "Once that anchor is removed, in the current environment the only direction left for rates along the entire yield curve is upward."

items.title: 一個月連吞兩大單！三星電機狂攬1.35兆韓元  AI伺服器MLCC產能直接鎖死到2027年底
items.title_en: Two Massive Deals in One Month! Samsung Electro-Mechanics Secures 1.35 Trillion Won; AI Server MLCC Capacity Locked Through End‑2027
paras: 南韓三星電機周二(29日)公告指出，與一家全球大型企業簽訂超過2850億韓元(約2.1億美元)供貨協議，2027年全年供應AI伺服器用MLCC與電感器，繼9月1日斬獲1.07兆韓元AI伺服器MLCC長約協議(LTA)後，一個月內第二筆大單。兩單均鎖定2027年交付，客戶身分因保密未披露，市場普遍指向北美雲端或伺服器大廠。
按公司披露門檻(超過年營收2.5%才公告)彙總，三星電機今年來已公開四筆AI伺服器MLCC長協：9月1日1.07兆、9月29日0.285兆、6月約0.454兆、7月約0.295兆韓元，合計2.11兆韓元，全部2027年執行，另公開約1.5兆韓元矽電容長協，部分2027至2028年供貨。
若計入電感器等LTA，三星電機年內相關LTA總額已超過3.6兆韓元，訂單能見度直達2027年底，反映高端MLCC不是「有單就交」，而是產能已被提前預定。
2025下半年至2026年2月，全球被動元件進入全品類漲價週期，普遍漲5%至30%，今年4月起新一輪漲價，原廠優先保供AI、車規大客戶，通路報價波動顯著。
AI伺服器對高容、耐高溫、低等效電阻要求遠高於消費品，單機用量數倍於通用伺服器，MLCC由「配角」變成算力BOM重要成本項。
供給端高度寡頭：日本村田全球市佔逾31%、三星電機逾22%、太陽誘電逾11%，加TDK、京瓷前五超77%。根據集邦數據，村田、三星電機、太陽誘電訂貨出貨比分別約1.3、1.31、1.25，訂單積壓明顯
但高端流延設備、陶瓷粉體交付週期12至24個月，日韓廠擴產審慎，主流機構判斷2027年底前大規模新增高端產能難以放量，使得客戶用LTA鎖產能、原廠用漲價篩需求，AI伺服器MLCC緊缺至少延續至2027年，車規與工控料號亦受擠佔。
對三星電機而言，LTA鎖營收、擴釜山與菲律賓高階產線，是承接AI週期的核心籌碼，對下游OEM則意味著成本與交期雙重不確定性。
paras_en: Samsung Electro-Mechanics of South Korea announced on Tuesday (the 29th) that it has signed a supply agreement worth more than 285 billion won (about $210 million) with a large global corporation to provide MLCCs and inductors for AI servers throughout 2027, marking a second huge order within a month after clinching a 1.07 trillion‑won long‑term agreement for AI server MLCCs on September 1. Both contracts are slated for delivery in 2027, and the customer’s identity remains confidential, though the market generally points to a major North American cloud or server vendor.

According to the company’s disclosure threshold (announcing contracts exceeding 2.5% of annual revenue), Samsung Electro-Mechanics has publicly disclosed four AI‑server MLCC long‑term agreements this year: 1.07 trillion won on September 1, 285 billion won on September 29, about 454 billion won in June and about 295 billion won in July, totaling roughly 2.11 trillion won, all to be executed in 2027. It has also disclosed about 1.5 trillion won of silicon‑capacitor long‑term contracts, some of which will be supplied from 2027 to 2028.

Including inductors and other LTA items, Samsung Electro-Mechanics’ related long‑term agreements this year have already exceeded 3.6 trillion won, giving order visibility through the end of 2027 and indicating that high‑end MLCCs are not “sell‑as‑you‑go” items but have their capacity pre‑reserved well in advance.

From the second half of 2025 to February 2026, the global passive‑component market entered a price‑increase cycle across all categories, with typical hikes of 5% to 30%. A new round of price increases began in April 2024, with original equipment manufacturers prioritising supply to AI and automotive‑grade customers, leading to noticeable volatility in channel pricing.

AI servers demand much higher capacitance, high‑temperature tolerance and low equivalent series resistance than consumer products, and the per‑unit consumption is several times that of generic servers. Consequently, MLCCs have shifted from a peripheral component to a major cost item on the compute‑power bill of materials.

The supply side is highly concentrated: Japan’s Murata holds over 31% of the global market, Samsung Electro‑Mechanics over 22%, Taiyo Yuden over 11%, with TDK and Kyocera rounding out the top five to more than 77% combined. According to TrendForce data, Murata, Samsung Electro‑Mechanics and Taiyo Yuden have order‑to‑shipment ratios of roughly 1.3, 1.31 and 1.25 respectively, indicating clear order backlogs.

However, high‑end tape‑casting equipment and ceramic powder have lead times of 12 to 24 months, and expansion plans in South Korea and Japan are cautious. Industry analysts judge that large‑scale addition of high‑end capacity before the end of 2027 will be difficult, prompting customers to lock capacity via LTAs and manufacturers to use price hikes to screen demand. This means a tight AI‑server MLCC supply will likely persist at least until 2027, with automotive‑grade and industrial‑control parts also being squeezed.

For Samsung Electro‑Mechanics, LTAs that lock in revenue and the expansion of advanced lines in Busan and the Philippines are core levers for capturing the AI cycle, while downstream OEMs face dual uncertainties in cost and delivery timelines.

items.title: OpenAI擬募資至少300億美元 估值上看1.4兆美元
items.title_en: OpenAI Plans to Raise at Least $30 B, Valuation Near $1.4 T
paras: 《彭博》引述匿名消息人士報導，OpenAI 正尋求在新一輪融資中籌集至少 300 億美元，估值約為 1.4 兆美元。目前討論仍處於初期階段，相關條件可能改變。
這輪融資旨在讓 OpenAI 延後上市之際，獲得更多資金以支應營運。執行長阿特曼 (Sam Altman) 表示，公司今年暫緩公開上市，並稱考量到 OpenAI 持續進行的 AI 安全工作，此時上市「並不明智」。一名知情人士表示，投資人對這輪融資的興趣，主要受到公司強勁營收成長動能帶動。
這輪融資對 OpenAI 的估值約為 1.4 兆美元，且尚未計入新募集的資金，已高於今年 3 月募資完成後的估值。
OpenAI 今年 3 月完成一輪 1,220 億美元融資，投資後估值達 8,520 億美元，由軟銀、亞馬遜 (AMZN-US) 與輝達 (NVDA-US) 領投，當時創下矽谷史上最大融資紀錄。
新估值也將超越 Anthropic 最近一次的私募市場估值。
《彭博》先前曾報導，OpenAI 考慮以 1.2 兆美元估值進行新一輪融資。
OpenAI 年化營收已突破 400 億美元，較 7 月成長 70%。該媒體也指出，OpenAI 已縮減每月 200 美元訂閱方案的部分使用額度。
此次募資之際，OpenAI 正面臨 AI 安全方面的壓力。
OpenAI 本週宣布，最新模型 GPT-6.1 Astra 未通過內部安全標準，因此將暫不發布。阿特曼也支持 Anthropic 執行長阿莫迪 (Dario Amodei) 提出的方案，主張放慢前沿 AI 開發步調，並引入外部評估人員檢驗技術安全性。
OpenAI 週二舉行年度 DevDay 開發者大會，發表名為 Dots 的新 AI 代理，以及每月 500 美元的新付費訂閱方案，提供更高使用額度與更快處理速度。
今年稍早，OpenAI 未達成自身設定的營收與新增用戶目標，引發內部對公司能否持續履行資料中心相關承諾的疑慮。
《華爾街日報》報導，財務長弗萊爾 (Sarah Friar) 曾向同事示警，營收成長疲弱可能使 OpenAI 無法履行未來的運算資源合約。
她也質疑，公司是否已準備好依照阿特曼偏好的IPO 時程，滿足公開市場的監管要求。
(本文不開放合作夥伴轉載)
paras_en: Bloomberg, citing anonymous sources, reports that OpenAI is seeking to raise at least $30 billion in a new financing round, valuing the company at roughly $1.4 trillion. The discussion is still in early stages and terms could change.

The round is intended to give OpenAI more capital to fund operations while it delays an IPO. CEO Sam Altman said the company will postpone a public listing this year, noting that, given OpenAI’s ongoing AI‑safety work, going public “would not be wise” at this time. An insider said investor interest is driven mainly by the company’s strong revenue‑growth momentum.
The financing would value OpenAI at about $1.4 trillion, not including the new capital raised, which is higher than the valuation after the March funding this year.

In March, OpenAI closed a $122 billion financing round that lifted its post‑money valuation to $852 billion, led by SoftBank, Amazon (AMZN‑US) and Nvidia (NVDA‑US), setting a record for the largest raise in Silicon Valley history.
The new valuation would also surpass the most recent private‑market valuation of Anthropic.
Bloomberg previously reported that OpenAI was considering a new round at a $1.2 trillion valuation.
OpenAI’s annualized revenue has now topped $40 billion, up 70% since July. The outlet also noted that OpenAI has trimmed the usage limits on its $200‑per‑month subscription tier.
The fundraising comes as OpenAI faces mounting pressure on AI safety issues.

This week OpenAI announced that its latest model, GPT‑6.1 Astra, failed internal safety standards and will not be released. Altman also backed a proposal from Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei to slow the pace of frontier AI development and bring in external reviewers to assess technical safety.
At its annual DevDay conference on Tuesday, OpenAI unveiled a new AI agent called Dots and introduced a $500‑per‑month premium subscription offering higher usage limits and faster processing speeds.
Earlier this year OpenAI missed its own revenue and new‑user targets, sparking internal doubts about the company’s ability to continue meeting its data‑center commitments.
The Wall Street Journal reported that CFO Sarah Friar warned colleagues that weak revenue growth could prevent OpenAI from fulfilling future compute‑resource contracts.
She also questioned whether the company is ready to meet public‑market regulatory requirements in line with Altman’s preferred IPO timeline.
(This article is not available for partner re‑publication)

items.title: 美國期中選舉恐成AI多頭隱憂！反數據中心情緒升溫　AI股、標普500面臨監管風險
items.title_en: Midterm U.S. Election May Pose AI Bullish Risk as Anti‑Data‑Center Sentiment Rises; AI Stocks and S&P 500 Face Regulatory Threats
paras: 美國期中選舉將於11月3日登場，市場近期持續展現韌性，標普500指數9月迄今仍維持正報酬，科技股更是主要推動力。不過，隨著反人工智慧（AI）及反資料中心情緒升溫，期中選舉可能成為AI交易持續走強的一項潛在風險。
根據《巴隆周刊》報導，今年9月以來，科技股表現明顯優於大盤。SPDR 科技指數 ETF(XLK-US) 本月上漲4.3%，同期標普500指數則大致持平。
這波表現主要受到AI題材帶動，即使美國公債殖利率處於歷史高檔、油價偏高，且聯準會（Fed）在財報空窗期升息，股市仍維持相對強勢。
不過，這次期中選舉的影響可能不同於過去，因為反AI情緒已成為部分地方及州層級選舉的推動因素，並可能促成對AI擴張構成威脅的立法。
分析指出，這將對標普500指數構成不利影響，因為目前指數接近歷史高點，但實際上是少數AI股票撐起整體表現，而指數表面強勢之下，可能已經隱藏著一場「隱性熊市」。
一般而言，期中選舉並不是投資人需要過度擔心的事情。政治雜音確實可能帶來市場波動，但很少會對市場長期走勢產生影響。
根據道瓊市場數據自1990年以來的統計，選舉年的芝加哥選擇權交易所市場波動率指數（VIX指數）平均高於20，相較之下，非選舉年則低於19。不過，無論期中選舉結果如何，股市通常仍會走高。
事實上，根據Capital Group的研究，自1933年以來，無論美國政府由單一政黨掌控、國會分裂，或國會由單一政黨控制但總統屬於另一政黨，標普500指數平均報酬率都達到兩位數。
Fidelity數據則顯示，自1950年以來，標普500指數在期中選舉後一年有95%的情況錄得正報酬。
然而，這次選舉可能成為判斷AI交易未來走向的重要指標。 Baird投資策略師Ross Mayfield表示，相較過去幾次選舉周期，他此次更加密切關注期中選舉。
他指出，目前最大的市場風險之一，是地方及州層級對資料中心的反對聲浪若持續升高，可能導致部分相關計畫放緩或延後。
Mayfield將AI目前面臨的公關危機，類比於2010年代水力壓裂產業曾遭遇的負面形象。
他表示，若AI資料中心面臨更多監管障礙，可能壓縮大型雲端業者的獲利能力，並進一步影響近年AI交易中的受惠股票，包括晶片製造商、能源類股、記憶體股以及資料中心REIT。
目前美國社會對資料中心的反對聲音並不局限於特定政治陣營或人口族群。皮尤研究中心（Pew Research）近期的調查結果顯示，約半數美國人認為資料中心對環境（54%）、家庭能源成本（50%）以及週邊居民的生活品質（49%）有著「大致有害」的影響。
相較今年初，民眾對資料中心的負面看法已明顯增加。值得注意的是，皮尤研究中心最新調查進行時，AI產業領袖尚未針對這項技術的潛在危險提出最新警告。
Aptus Capital Investments股票主管David Wagner表示：「目前，可負擔性是關鍵議題，而AI資本支出將持續成為一個容易被歸咎的對象，被視為造成可負擔性問題的主要原因。」
不過，Wagner補充，他不認為反AI疑慮會讓企業資本支出計畫或AI交易本身脫軌，但這些疑慮可能影響市場情緒，最終對相關股票造成壓力。
Mayfield也持類似看法。他表示，這類監管對大型雲端業者而言會是「令人困擾」，而非「致命」的問題，但仍會對企業獲利造成影響。
報導指出，地方及州政府立法所帶來的額外成本，若進一步壓縮企業利潤率，將是股東不樂見的變化；而考慮到受影響股票在市場中的高度集中，這項問題的重要性也會進一步放大。
高盛股票策略團隊週一發布報告指出，儘管標普500指數成分股的中位數目前仍較52週高點低16%，但AI類股的強勁表現仍支撐該指數維持韌性。該團隊指出，目前市場廣度已降至網路泡沫時期以來最低水準。
如果期中選舉後出現反AI監管措施，可能拖累AI股票，並進一步暴露整體市場原本存在的弱勢。因此，這一次，選舉帶來的政治雜音或許不再是可以置之不理的市場訊號。
paras_en: The U.S. midterm election will be held on November 3, and markets have recently shown resilience, with the S&P 500 still posting positive returns through September and tech stocks serving as the main driver. However, rising anti‑AI and anti‑data‑center sentiment could make the midterms a potential risk to the continued strength of AI‑related trading.

According to Barron’s, tech stocks have outperformed the broader market since September. The SPDR Technology ETF (XLK‑US) is up 4.3% this month, while the S&P 500 has been roughly flat over the same period.

This performance is largely driven by AI themes, even as U.S. Treasury yields sit at historic highs, oil prices remain elevated, and the Fed raises rates during the earnings‑reporting lull, the equity market stays relatively strong.

But the impact of this midterm election may differ from past cycles because anti‑AI sentiment has become a motivating factor in some local and state races and could lead to legislation that threatens AI expansion.

Analysts say this could weigh on the S&P 500 because the index is near historic highs but is currently being propped up by a handful of AI stocks; beneath the surface strength may be a hidden bear market.
Generally, midterms are not something investors need to worry about excessively. Political noise can cause short‑term volatility but rarely alters the market’s long‑term trajectory.

Data from the Dow Jones market since 1990 shows that the VIX averages above 20 in election years, compared with below 19 in non‑election years. Nonetheless, regardless of the midterm outcome, stocks usually keep climbing.

In fact, Capital Group research finds that since 1933, the S&P 500 has delivered double‑digit average returns whether the government is controlled by a single party, Congress is divided, or Congress is one party while the president is another.
Fidelity data shows that since 1950, the S&P 500 has posted positive returns in 95% of the years following a midterm election.

However, this election could become a key gauge for the future direction of AI trading. Baird investment strategist Ross Mayfield says he is watching the midterms more closely than in previous cycles.
He notes that one of the biggest market risks now is a growing backlash against data centers at the local and state level, which could slow or delay related projects.
Mayfield likens the current PR crisis facing AI to the negative image the hydraulic fracturing industry suffered in the 2010s.

He warns that if AI data centers encounter more regulatory hurdles, it could compress the profitability of large cloud providers and, in turn, affect the AI‑benefiting stocks of recent years, including chip makers, energy firms, memory stocks, and data‑center REITs.

Opposition to data centers in the U.S. is not confined to any single political camp or demographic. A recent Pew Research survey found roughly half of Americans view data centers as “somewhat harmful” to the environment (54%), household energy costs (50%) and nearby residents’ quality of life (49%).

Compared with early this year, public perception of data centers has worsened noticeably. Notably, when Pew conducted its latest poll, AI industry leaders had not issued new warnings about the technology’s potential dangers.

Aptus Capital Investments equity head David Wagner said, “Affordability is the key issue right now, and AI cap‑ex will continue to be an easy scapegoat, seen as a primary cause of affordability problems.”
Wagner added that he does not believe anti‑AI concerns will derail corporate cap‑ex plans or AI trading itself, but they could affect market sentiment and ultimately pressure related stocks.
Mayfield shares a similar view, saying such regulation would be “troubling” for large cloud providers rather than “fatal,” though it would still impact corporate earnings.

The report notes that extra costs from local and state legislation, if they further squeeze profit margins, would be unwelcome for shareholders; given the high concentration of affected stocks, the issue’s importance would be amplified.

Goldman Sachs’ equity strategy team said on Monday that although the median S&P 500 constituent is still 16% below its 52‑week high, strong AI‑stock performance continues to underpin the index’s resilience, and market breadth has fallen to its lowest level since the dot‑com bubble.

If post‑midterm anti‑AI regulations emerge, they could drag down AI stocks and expose underlying market weaknesses, making the political noise from this election a signal that can no longer be ignored.

items.title: Muse衝擊消費股！克雷默：部分遭錯殺股票值得留意
items.title_en: Muse Shakes Up Consumer Stocks! Jim Cramer: Some Over‑Sold Shares Worth Watching
paras: Meta Platforms (META-US)推出的AI代理人Muse近期快速普及，正引發華爾街重新評估一批依賴「消費慣性」的企業。CNBC知名財經節目主持人克雷默(Jim Cramer)表示，Muse確實可能改變消費者尋找商品、比較價格、預訂服務及取消訂閱的方式，但市場近期對相關消費股的拋售也可能過於劇烈，部分遭重挫企業值得進一步檢視。
Muse於9月8日推出，定位為能代表使用者執行實際任務的個人AI代理人，不只是回答問題，而是可以在獲得授權後連接第三方服務，協助處理購物、旅遊預訂、客服及訂閱管理等工作。Muse快速登上蘋果美國App Store免費應用程式排行榜前列，使投資人開始重新思考AI代理人對既有消費商業模式的影響。
市場最關注的是所謂「消費慣性」企業，也就是消費者因習慣、便利性或自動扣款而持續使用服務，即使市場上存在價格更低或條件更好的替代方案，仍不一定主動更換供應商。
高盛分析師將電信、保險、旅遊及部分金融服務企業列入可能受到AI代理人影響的範圍。相關企業的共同特徵是消費者通常需要主動比較價格、重新申請服務或花費時間更換供應商，因此過去的搜尋成本與轉換障礙，有助於維持客戶關係。
Muse若能自行比較不同供應商、尋找更低價格，甚至代替使用者處理取消訂閱及重新申請服務等工作，理論上可能降低這些轉換成本，使消費者更容易離開原有服務。

這項擔憂已反映在股價上。高盛的「消費慣性」股票籃子在Muse推出後一度下跌約10%。電信業者AT&T (T-US)與T-Mobile US (TMUS-US)、保險公司Allstate (ALL-US)與Progressive (PGR-US)、串流平台Netflix (NFLX-US)及Paramount Skydance (PSKY-US)，以及線上旅遊平台Expedia Group (EXPE-US)與Booking Holdings (BKNG-US)均受到市場拋售壓力。
其中，9月22日市場交易尤其劇烈。Allstate股價一度下跌約5.5%，Charles Schwab (SCHW-US)跌幅超過5%，Expedia一度下跌3.7%，Booking Holdings下跌3.9%，健身連鎖業者Planet Fitness (PLNT-US)一度重挫11%。金融股及保險股也受到AI可能提高消費者比價能力的疑慮拖累。
不過，克雷默認為，投資人需要區分AI可能帶來的長期商業模式變化，以及短期市場情緒造成的股價反應。他指出，Muse確實可能讓消費者更容易比較價格、尋找替代方案及取消不需要的服務，但這不代表相關企業的營收與獲利會立即遭到破壞。
部分華爾街分析也持相對保留的看法。美銀分析師認為，AI提高保險產品價格透明度後，未必只會對保險業者造成負面影響。對於具備較佳核保能力、較少定價錯誤及規模經濟優勢的保險公司而言，更透明的市場也可能讓競爭優勢更加明顯。
Truist Securities則認為，市場對AI代理人衝擊Charles Schwab等券商業者的擔憂可能過度。分析師指出，消費者目前對AI處理高價值金融決策的信任程度仍然不高，因此AI代理人要完全取代消費者在投資、金融產品及資產管理方面的決策，仍存在相當大的障礙。
市場近期甚至出現部分與Meta合作的企業股價遭到拋售的情況。Expedia、Shopify (SHOP-US)、PayPal (PYPL-US)及Instacart等企業都受到Muse相關交易及購物功能發展的市場情緒影響。這反映投資人目前不只是擔心AI代理人搶走消費者，也開始重新評估哪些企業能夠從AI代理人的普及中取得商業利益。
Shopify與PayPal的情況尤其值得注意。兩家公司都已與Meta的Muse建立合作關係，讓Muse能夠協助消費者搜尋商品、完成購物流程或處理付款。換言之，AI代理人的發展可能同時對部分企業構成競爭威脅，也可能成為新的銷售與交易入口。
Meta則試圖將Muse打造為連接消費者與企業服務的新介面。除了購物之外，Muse可以透過連接器與第三方服務互動，使使用者能夠透過自然語言完成原本需要在不同網站及App之間反覆操作的工作。
這種模式可能改變消費者與品牌之間的關係。過去消費者可能直接打開電信、保險、旅遊或購物App，再自行比較產品；未來則可能先向AI代理人提出需求，由代理人代為搜尋、比較並執行交易。
對企業而言，這代表品牌忠誠度可能不再只是建立在消費者熟悉度或使用習慣之上。如果AI代理人成為新的購物入口，企業除了爭取消費者，也可能需要爭取被AI代理人推薦的機會。
然而，這種轉變目前仍處於早期階段。Muse雖然快速累積使用者，但AI代理人是否能夠大規模取代消費者目前的搜尋、比較及交易習慣，仍有待時間驗證。資料隱私、交易授權、錯誤推薦及消費者對AI執行高價值交易的信任程度，都可能限制其普及速度。
此外，部分企業也開始採取防禦措施。亞馬遜 (AMZN-US)已限制Muse等未經授權的AI代理人直接在Amazon.com上進行購物，顯示AI代理人與既有大型平台之間的利益衝突正在浮現。若未來更多企業限制AI代理人的存取權限，Muse能夠執行的任務範圍也可能受到影響。
另一方面，AI代理人也可能替消費者創造更多交易。當搜尋、比較及付款等流程變得更加容易，部分原本因時間成本而沒有完成的購物或預訂行為，反而可能因此增加。對能夠順利接入AI代理人平台的企業而言，這可能形成新的客戶來源。
因此，目前市場面臨的是兩種力量同時作用。一方面，Muse可能削弱依靠消費者懶得比較、懶得取消或懶得轉換供應商而形成的收入；另一方面，AI降低交易摩擦後，也可能刺激新的消費需求。
克雷默的看法因此並非單純認為所有遭Muse衝擊的消費股都會持續承壓，而是認為投資人應該進一步區分企業本身的競爭優勢、客戶黏著度及AI帶來的實際威脅。
目前市場對「消費慣性」股票的重新定價，更多反映的是投資人對未來商業模式可能改變的預期，而非企業已經出現明確的營收或獲利崩跌。Muse究竟會讓這些企業失去客戶，還是成為新的交易入口，仍取決於AI代理人的實際使用規模、消費者信任，以及企業能否適應新的消費流程。
對相關股票而言，接下來市場將更加關注實際用戶數、AI代理人的交易量、企業與AI平台的合作方式，以及消費者是否真的開始頻繁透過AI比較價格、轉換供應商與取消訂閱。這些數據將比Muse初期帶來的股價波動，更能反映AI代理人對消費產業的長期影響。
paras_en: Meta Platforms (META-US) has recently seen its AI agent Muse spread quickly, prompting Wall Street to reassess a group of companies that rely on "consumer inertia." CNBC veteran host Jim Cramer said Muse could indeed change how consumers search for products, compare prices, book services and cancel subscriptions, but the recent sell‑off in related consumer stocks may have been overly harsh, and some heavily hit firms deserve a closer look.

Muse launched on September 8 as a personal AI agent that can act on behalf of users to perform real tasks—not just answer questions—but also, with permission, connect to third‑party services to help with shopping, travel bookings, customer service and subscription management. Muse quickly rose to the top of Apple’s U.S. App Store free‑app chart, causing investors to rethink the impact of AI agents on existing consumer business models.

The market’s focus is on so‑called "consumer‑inertia" companies, where consumers keep using a service out of habit, convenience or automatic billing even when cheaper or better alternatives exist, and they may not proactively switch providers.

Goldman Sachs analysts have flagged telecom, insurance, travel and certain financial‑services firms as potentially vulnerable to AI agents. These firms share the trait that customers usually have to actively compare prices, reapply for services or spend time switching providers, so past search costs and switching barriers have helped maintain customer relationships.

If Muse can compare suppliers, find lower prices and even handle subscription cancellations and re‑applications for users, it could theoretically lower those switching costs and make it easier for consumers to leave existing services.

That concern is already reflected in stock prices. Goldman’s "consumer‑inertia" basket fell about 10% after Muse’s debut. Telecoms AT&T (T‑US) and T‑Mobile US (TMUS‑US), insurers Allstate (ALL‑US) and Progressive (PGR‑US), streaming platforms Netflix (NFLX‑US) and Paramount Skydance (PSKY‑US), as well as online travel sites Expedia Group (EXPE‑US) and Booking Holdings (BKNG‑US) all faced selling pressure.

The market was especially volatile on September 22. Allstate dropped roughly 5.5%, Charles Schwab (SCHW‑US) fell more than 5%, Expedia slid 3.7%, Booking Holdings fell 3.9% and fitness chain Planet Fitness (PLNT‑US) plunged 11%. Financial and insurance stocks were also weighed down by worries that AI could boost consumers’ price‑comparison power.

Cramer, however, says investors need to separate the long‑term business‑model changes AI might bring from the short‑term sentiment‑driven price moves. He notes Muse could indeed make price comparison, alternative‑searching and unwanted‑service cancellation easier, but that doesn’t mean affected companies’ revenue and earnings will be immediately damaged.

Some Wall Street analysts are more cautious. A Bank of America analyst believes that while AI may increase price transparency for insurance products, it won’t necessarily harm insurers. Companies with stronger underwriting, fewer pricing errors and economies of scale could see their competitive edge sharpen in a more transparent market.

Truist Securities argues that fears about AI agents hurting broker‑dealers like Charles Schwab may be overstated. The analyst points out that consumers still have low trust in AI handling high‑value financial decisions, so AI agents face significant hurdles before they can fully replace human judgment in investing, financial products and asset management.

Recently, stocks of companies that have partnered with Meta have also been sold off. Expedia, Shopify (SHOP‑US), PayPal (PYPL‑US) and Instacart have all felt market pressure from Muse‑related transaction and shopping functionality news, reflecting investors’ broader reassessment of which firms can profit from AI agent adoption.

Shopify and PayPal are especially noteworthy. Both have teamed up with Meta’s Muse to let the agent help consumers search for products, complete purchases or handle payments. In other words, AI agents could simultaneously pose a competitive threat to some firms while also opening new sales and transaction channels.

Meta is trying to make Muse a new interface that links consumers with enterprise services. Beyond shopping, Muse can interact with third‑party services via connectors, allowing users to complete tasks that would otherwise require hopping between multiple websites and apps using natural language commands.

This model could reshape the consumer‑brand relationship. Previously, a shopper might open a telecom, insurance, travel or retail app and compare products themselves; in the future they may first state their need to an AI agent, which then searches, compares and executes the transaction on their behalf.

For companies, this means brand loyalty may no longer rest solely on familiarity or habit. If AI agents become the primary shopping gateway, firms will have to compete not just for the consumer’s attention but also for the agent’s recommendation.

However, the shift is still in its early days. Although Muse is rapidly gaining users, whether AI agents can replace consumers’ current search, comparison and purchasing habits at scale remains to be seen. Data‑privacy concerns, transaction authorizations, erroneous recommendations and trust in AI for high‑value deals could all slow adoption.

Some firms are already taking defensive steps. Amazon (AMZN‑US) has blocked unauthorized AI agents like Muse from shopping directly on Amazon.com, highlighting emerging conflicts of interest between AI agents and large platforms. If more companies restrict AI access, Muse’s range of executable tasks could be limited.

Conversely, AI agents could also generate more transactions. When searching, comparing and paying become easier, some purchases or bookings that were previously abandoned due to time costs might actually increase, creating new customer sources for businesses that integrate smoothly with AI platforms.

Thus, the market is facing two opposing forces. On one hand, Muse could erode revenue streams that depend on consumers’ reluctance to compare, cancel or switch providers; on the other, reduced transaction friction could spark fresh consumer demand.

Cramer’s view is therefore not that every consumer stock hit by Muse will stay under pressure, but that investors should differentiate each company’s competitive advantages, customer stickiness and the actual AI‑related threat it faces.

The current re‑pricing of "consumer‑inertia" stocks reflects investors’ expectations of possible business‑model shifts rather than clear‑cut revenue or profit collapses. Whether Muse will strip these firms of customers or become a new transaction conduit depends on the scale of AI‑agent usage, consumer trust and firms’ ability to adapt to new buying flows.

Going forward, the market will watch actual user numbers, AI‑agent transaction volumes, the nature of company‑AI partnerships and whether consumers truly begin to rely on AI for frequent price comparisons, provider switches and subscription cancellations. Those metrics will tell a more accurate story of AI agents’ long‑term impact on the consumer sector than Muse’s initial stock‑price turbulence.

台股盤前要聞

1.台股昨(29)日為連假結束後首個交易日，受美伊談判停滯、油價上揚，加上美債殖利率走升，指數開低走低，盤中一度下跌超過440點，盤面上以塑化、LED類股及季底集團作帳族群表現較佳，終場下跌392.64點或0.82%，收47,631.96點，失守4萬8千點及5日線，成交量略增，收7,850.39億元。

4.中華電信(2412-TW)網路技術分公司總經理賈仲雍昨(29)日出席2026 ITRI ICT TechDay，分享中華電信海地星空的韌性布局規劃，指出與美國衛星公司Astranis合作的台灣首顆自主衛星，預計明年開始提供服務。
5.聯嘉光電投控(3717-TW)昨(29)日指出，墨西哥新廠多個汽車專案將於第四季放量投產，同時，積極新增非車燈車用電子客戶，與北美製造剛需客戶洽談中，目標成為AI光通訊重要供應鏈。

paras_en: Taiwan stocks on the first trading day after the holiday (the 29th) opened lower and continued to fall, pressured by stalled US‑Iran talks, rising oil prices and higher US Treasury yields. The index dropped more than 440 points intraday and closed down 392.64 points, or 0.82%, at 47,631.96, breaking the 48,000‑point mark and the five‑day moving average. Volume was slightly up, with a turnover of NT$7,850.39 billion. Plastics, LED stocks and year‑end‑closing groups performed relatively better.

PCB manufacturer Jinxiang Electronics (2368‑TW) announced a private‑placement capital increase on the 29th, issuing about 1,856 new shares at NT$856 each, raising roughly NT$1.589 billion. The most eye‑catching participant was Amazon (AMZN‑US), marking its first time holding Jinxiang shares and signalling a deeper cooperation between the two companies.

China Chemical (1727‑TW) and four subsidiaries of the Formosa Plastics Group announced in the afternoon of the 29th that, to expand their electronic‑grade sulfuric acid business and pool resources, they will jointly establish a new joint‑venture, Formosa‑China Advanced Chemical Co., Ltd., with a total capital of NT$6 billion. China Chemical and the Formosa group will each hold a 50% stake.

Chunghwa Telecom (2412‑TW) Network Technology Division General Manager Chia Jung‑Yong attended the 2026 ITRI ICT TechDay on the 29th, sharing the resilient layout plan of Chunghwa’s “Haiti Starry Sky” project. He highlighted the collaboration with US satellite firm Astranis on Taiwan’s first domestically‑developed satellite, which is expected to begin service next year.

Lianjia Optoelectronics Investment Holding (3717‑TW) said on the 29th that its new plant in Mexico will ramp up production on several automotive projects in Q4. The company is also actively adding non‑automotive lighting and automotive electronics customers, negotiating with North‑American manufacturing clients, and aims to become a key supplier in the AI optical‑communication supply chain.

MLCC maker Hoshin (3026‑TW) reported on the 29th that its August net profit was NT$220 million, down 4% month‑over‑month but up 285% year‑over‑year, with earnings per share of NT$1.33. Cumulative net profit for the first eight months reached about NT$1.567 billion, or NT$9.45 per share.

CNBC reported that Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) said on Monday (the 28th) it had agreed to acquire AI research firm World Labs, based in San Francisco, for US$8.2 billion. The company was founded by AI pioneer Fei‑Fei Li.

Post‑market Taiwan‑stock headline: After the holiday, the market slipped another 392 points as oil prices and US‑Treasury yields hit simultaneously, pushing the index below the 48,000 level and the five‑day moving average.
Jinxiang Electronics secured nearly NT$1.6 billion from Amazon’s participation in its private‑placement capital increase, further advancing the cooperation between the two firms.
Four Formosa Plastics Group companies join China Chemical to set up a new joint‑venture, each holding over half of the equity, to develop an electronic‑grade sulfuric acid plant.
Chunghwa Telecom: Taiwan’s first domestically‑developed satellite is slated to provide services in 2027.
Lianjia moves into VCSEL technology, aiming to become a component of the AI optical‑communication supply chain.

AMD is spending US$8.2 billion to acquire Fei‑Fei Li’s World Labs, hoping to get ahead in the next‑generation AI chip race.

paras: 為維持金融檢查作業透明度並輔導業者自律，金管會今(29)日依據「金融檢查指導原則」，正式公布 2026 年度上半年金融機構主要檢查缺失及改善做法。本次檢查涵蓋金融控股公司、本國銀行、外商銀行、信合社、電支機構、投信、票券、證券及產壽險等 10 個業別，主要缺失焦點集中於「防制詐騙與洗錢」、「消費者保護」、「內部管理」及「資訊安全」四大領域。其中，銀行辦理房貸業務時是否「不當搭售房貸壽險」及「人頭戶防範」等議題，也成為關注焦點。
金管會指出，在防制洗錢與打擊資恐方面，部分金融機構存在嚴重漏洞。有客戶由「籌備處」變更為正式公司後，銀行未落實開戶審查，導致未能發現該公司符合警政署公布的人頭公司特徵，開戶後不久即遭 165 聯防通報。
此外，部分業者受理警察機關通報警示的電子支付帳戶後，未依規定第一時間通報聯徵中心；也有法人客戶已觸發多次疑似洗錢交易警示、資金快進快出且與一般公司營運模式不符，銀行卻未深入瞭解交易真實性。金管會強調，金融機構應落實開戶審查與持續交易監控，建立嚴密防線。
在消費者保護領域，金檢發現有銀行辦理房屋貸款時，未充分告知客戶可自主選擇是否投保房貸壽險，導致客戶誤以為投保為核貸的「必要條件」，甚至有業務員以「爭取較低利率」勸誘客戶投保。
對於媒體關心房貸壽險搭售情形是否嚴重，金管會檢查局副局長郭文龍回應，金檢抽查時發現有客戶在貸款諮詢的電話錄音中對利率與搭售表達疑慮，顯示銀行員在說明時未讓客戶清楚了解「擁有自主選擇權」或造成客戶誤解。郭文龍重申，金管會早已多次宣導「不得以買房貸壽險作為貸款搭售條件」，業務局後續將根據金檢報告與違規事實，評估是否進行相關處分。
此外，消保缺失還包括：業者未有效建置「客戶與理專/業務員通訊地址相同」的比對監控機制；基金廣告未平衡揭露獲利與風險；以及向非專業投資人推介具損失吸收能力(TLAC)債券等情況。
在授信與內部管理方面，金檢發現有金融機構辦理住宅及企業建築放款時，將未經主管機關核定的購地或重劃案件，逕自排除在《銀行法》第 72 條之 2 限額控管之外。
郭文龍解釋，部分都更或獎勵投資條例案件雖可依法免列入 72 條之 2 限制，但部分金融機構未經詳細查證就直接排除，顯見作業不夠審慎，已要求業者確實依規檢視資金用途。另外，金檢也發現部分機構未落實董事等利害關係人的資料申報與建檔，導致授信或交易前無法準確比對。
資訊安全為金融業運營根本，但金檢顯示，部分金融機構的對外服務網站引用了不安全的第三方函式庫；作業系統主機未建立安全強化標準，且最高權限帳號由管理人員自行持有、未納入集中管理或定期清查。
此外，行動應用程式管理也出現基本資安檢測不完整、參數設定允許明文傳輸，甚至嵌入的廠商安控軟體(SDK)含有中高風險漏洞卻未修補即上架等問題。金管會要求業者全面檢討網頁與 APP 安全設計，落實漏洞修補與帳號權限控管。
paras_en: To maintain transparency of financial inspections and guide industry self‑regulation, the Financial Supervisory Commission (FSC) today (the 29th) announced, based on the “Financial Inspection Guidance Principles,” the main inspection deficiencies and remedial actions for financial institutions in the first half of 2026. The review covered ten sectors – financial holding companies, domestic banks, foreign banks, credit cooperatives, electronic payment firms, investment trusts, bill‑issuing companies, securities firms, and life‑insurance providers – with key issues concentrated in four areas: anti‑fraud and anti‑money‑laundering, consumer protection, internal management, and information security. Among them, whether banks improperly bundled mortgage life insurance with home‑loan products and the handling of “front‑person” accounts became focal points.

The FSC noted serious gaps in anti‑money‑laundering and counter‑terror‑financing controls at some institutions. In one case, a client that transitioned from a “pre‑incorporation” stage to a formal company was allowed to open an account without proper due‑diligence, despite matching the police‑defined characteristics of a front‑person company; the account was flagged shortly after opening by the 165 Joint Prevention Hotline.

Furthermore, some firms failed to promptly report electronic‑payment accounts flagged by police alerts to the Credit Information Center as required, and corporate clients that triggered multiple suspicious‑transaction alerts – showing rapid inflows and outflows inconsistent with normal business operations – were not thoroughly investigated by the banks. The FSC stressed that institutions must enforce rigorous account opening checks and continuous transaction monitoring to build a strong defensive line.

In the consumer‑protection domain, inspections found that certain banks did not adequately inform borrowers that purchasing mortgage life insurance was optional, leading customers to mistakenly believe it was a prerequisite for loan approval. Some sales staff even urged clients to buy the insurance by promising lower interest rates.

Addressing media concerns about the severity of mortgage‑insurance bundling, FSC Inspection Bureau Deputy Director Guo Wen‑long said that spot checks revealed callers expressing doubts about interest rates and bundling during loan‑consultation calls, indicating that bank staff failed to clearly convey customers’ right to choose or caused misunderstandings. Guo reiterated that the FSC has repeatedly warned that “mortgage life insurance must not be used as a condition for loan approval,” and the Business Bureau will assess whether to impose penalties based on inspection reports and any violations.

Other consumer‑protection shortcomings include the lack of a monitoring mechanism to match customers’ contact addresses with those of their financial advisers or sales staff, fund advertisements that do not balance profit disclosures with risk disclosures, and the promotion of TLAC (Total Loss‑Absorbing Capacity) bonds to non‑professional investors.

Regarding credit granting and internal management, inspections discovered that some institutions excluded land‑purchase or rezoning projects not approved by regulators from the loan‑amount caps stipulated in Article 72‑2 of the Banking Act when issuing residential and commercial construction loans.

Guo explained that while certain urban‑renewal or incentive‑investment projects can be lawfully exempt from the Article 72‑2 limit, some banks excluded projects without thorough verification, showing insufficient diligence. The FSC has ordered firms to rigorously examine fund usage according to regulations. Additionally, the inspection found that some institutions failed to collect and file conflict‑of‑interest information for directors and related parties, hindering accurate verification before credit decisions or transactions.

Information security is fundamental to financial operations, yet the inspection showed that some institutions’ external service websites used insecure third‑party libraries; operating‑system servers lacked hardened security standards; and privileged accounts were held by individual administrators without centralized management or periodic audits.

Mobile‑app management also exhibited basic security testing gaps, allowing plaintext transmission settings, and embedded vendor SDKs contained medium‑to‑high‑risk vulnerabilities that were not patched before release. The FSC has ordered firms to comprehensively review web and app security designs, implement vulnerability remediation, and enforce strict account‑permission controls.

items.title: AI PCB資本合作升級！Amazon砸15.9億元入股金像電，79億元新廠CapEx同步啟動
items.title_en: AI PCB Capital Partnership Upgrade! Amazon Invests NT$1.589 Billion in Jinxiang Electronics, NT$7.9 Billion New Plant CapEx Launched Simultaneously
paras: 2026年09月29日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ AI伺服器需求持續帶動PCB供應鏈擴產，金像電(2368-TW)29日公告，Amazon將以策略投資人身分參與私募，認購185萬6,308股，每股856元，估算投資金額約15.89億元。金像電同日也核准79億元新廠土地、建廠及設備投資，預計自2026年第4季起陸續投入。
此次私募參考價格為每股1,070元，實際認購價856元，相當於參考價的80%；若與金像電29日收盤價1,120元相比，認購價低約23.6%。不過，本次私募對象限定為策略性投資人，相關股票原則上自交付日起三年內不得自由轉讓。
金像電目前已切入AWS Trainium伺服器供應鏈，Trainium 3預計於2026年第3季量產，法人預期AWS相關產品將自第3季開始放量，並帶動下半年出貨攀升。
在既有供應鏈合作基礎上，Amazon進一步透過私募成為策略投資人，使雙方關係從產品供應延伸至資本合作。市場後續將關注Amazon入股後，是否進一步帶動Trainium伺服器、高速網通及資料中心相關PCB訂單。
金像電同日核准的79億元投資中，土地預算約38億元，建廠及設備資本支出約41億元，資金來源規畫透過無擔保可轉換公司債支應。

paras_en: September 29, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – Continuing demand for AI servers is driving expansion in the PCB supply chain. Jinxiang Electronics (2368‑TW) announced on the 29th that Amazon will participate in a private placement as a strategic investor, subscribing to 1,856,308 shares at NT$856 per share, an estimated investment of about NT$1.589 billion. On the same day, Jinxiang also approved a NT$7.9 billion investment for land, construction and equipment for a new plant, expected to be rolled out starting in Q4 2026.

The reference price for this private placement was NT$1,070 per share, but the actual subscription price was NT$856, roughly 80% of the reference price; compared with Jinxiang’s closing price of NT$1,120 on the 29th, the subscription price is about 23.6% lower. However, the private placement is limited to strategic investors, and the shares are generally restricted from free transfer for three years from the delivery date.

Jinxiang has already entered the AWS Trainium server supply chain, with Trainium 3 slated for mass production in Q3 2026. Analysts expect AWS‑related products to ramp up from Q3 onward, boosting shipments in the second half of the year.

Building on existing supply‑chain cooperation, Amazon’s private‑placement investment makes it a strategic shareholder, extending the relationship from product supply to capital partnership. The market will watch whether Amazon’s stake further drives orders for Trainium servers, high‑speed networking, and data‑center‑related PCBs.

Of the NT$7.9 billion approved investment, about NT$3.8 billion is allocated for land acquisition and roughly NT$4.1 billion for plant construction and equipment. The funding is planned to be sourced through unsecured convertible corporate bonds.

items.title: H1科學園區營收年增29.27%創同期新高 國科會：受惠AI、雲端需求爆發性成長
items.title_en: H1 Science Park Revenue Up 29.27% YoY, Hits Record High; Council Highlights Explosive Growth from AI and Cloud Demand
paras: 國科會於今(29)日宣布，今(2026)年上半年受惠全球AI應用持續深化及高效能運算(HPC)技術加速發展，催生AI晶片與雲端服務的爆發性需求，驅動半導體業迎來成長浪潮，科學園區上半年營收達3.54兆元、年增29.27%，再創歷史同期新高。其中竹科營收1.12兆元、年增36.03%表現最佳；中科0.65兆元、年增20.63%；南科1.77兆元、年增28.57%。
科學園區2026年上半年營業額3.54兆元，較同期成長29.27%，再創歷史新高，其中竹科1.12兆元，較2025年上半年成長36.03%；中科0.65兆元，成長20.63%；南科1.77兆元，成長28.57%。’
國科會指出，進一步分析各產業成長情形，園區共六大產業也全面成長，積體電路產業在高效能運算(HPC)與AI應用需求帶動下，營收年增29.57%；光電產業雖然面板出貨動能放緩，但憑藉光纖通訊模組訂單增加，及不斷電系統銷售持續成長，營收平穩成長6.3%；電腦及周邊產業受惠AI應用深化及雲端服務需求強勁，帶動伺服器及相關週邊設備出貨動能豐沛，推升整體營收大幅成長82.49%。
精密機械產業同樣搭上AI應用浪潮及全球半導體相關產業擴展熱絡，帶動精密設備、自動化系統及精密元組件需求，年增37.65%；生物技術產業因醫療器材及新藥行銷策略發酵，加上CDMO(委託開發暨製造服務)專案顯著挹注效益，使營收年增17.44%；通訊產業則受惠主流網路通訊設備規格轉換動能，帶動上游關鍵元件銷售成長，年增13.01%。
展望下半年，國科會指出，全球經濟雖仍受地緣政治風險與全球貿易關稅成本轉嫁的雙重考驗，但在AI應用浪潮持續推升及半導體先進製程的優勢下，園區廠商將透過強化供應鏈韌性、深化客戶夥伴關係，全面提升全球市場的戰略競爭力。
國科會強調，目前參酌科學園區上半年營運趨勢及各大研究機構預測2026年經濟成長率，預估2026全年營業額將可交出亮眼的成績單。
paras_en: The Council of Science and Technology announced today (the 29th) that the first half of 2026 benefited from the deepening of global AI applications and the accelerated development of high‑performance computing (HPC) technology, sparking explosive demand for AI chips and cloud services and driving a growth wave in the semiconductor industry. Science park revenue reached NT$3.54 trillion in the first half, up 29.27% year‑over‑year, setting a new historical high for the same period. Among the parks, Hsinchu Science Park posted NT$1.12 trillion, up 36.03% and the best performer; Central Taiwan Science Park recorded NT$0.65 trillion, up 20.63%; and Southern Taiwan Science Park generated NT$1.77 trillion, up 28.57%.

Science park revenue for the first half of 2026 was NT$3.54 trillion, a 29.27% increase over the same period last year, again a historic high. Hsinchu contributed NT$1.12 trillion, up 36.03% from the first half of 2025; Central Taiwan added NT$0.65 trillion, up 20.63%; and Southern Taiwan posted NT$1.77 trillion, up 28.57%.

The Council noted that, when breaking down growth by sector, all six major industries in the park expanded. The integrated circuit sector, driven by HPC and AI demand, saw revenue rise 29.57% year‑over‑year. The optoelectronics sector, despite a slowdown in panel shipments, maintained steady growth of 6.3% thanks to increased fiber‑optic communication module orders and continued sales of uninterruptible power systems. The computer and peripherals sector benefited from deeper AI applications and strong cloud service demand, boosting server and related peripheral shipments and lifting overall revenue by a striking 82.49%.

The precision machinery sector also rode the AI wave and the global expansion of semiconductor‑related industries, driving demand for precision equipment, automation systems and precision components, resulting in a 37.65% revenue increase. The biotechnology sector saw a 17.44% rise as medical device and new‑drug marketing strategies matured and CDMO (contract development and manufacturing organization) projects delivered significant benefits. The communications sector benefited from a shift in mainstream network equipment specifications, spurring growth in upstream key component sales and delivering a 13.01% increase.

Looking ahead to the second half of the year, the Council said that although the global economy still faces the dual challenges of geopolitical risks and the pass‑through of worldwide trade‑tariff costs, the ongoing AI wave and the advantages of advanced semiconductor processes will enable park firms to strengthen supply‑chain resilience and deepen customer‑partner relationships, thereby enhancing their strategic competitiveness in global markets.

The Council emphasized that, based on the first‑half operating trends of the science parks and forecasts from major research institutions for 2026 economic growth, the full‑year 2026 revenue is expected to deliver an impressive performance.

items.title: 北市府率12家台企訪「新加坡科技周」 展AI整合實力拓展東南亞商機
items.title_en: Taipei City Government Leads 12 Taiwanese Companies to Singapore Tech Week, Showcasing AI Integration Strength to Expand Southeast Asian Opportunities
paras: 台北市產發局繼去(2025)年參展取得豐碩成果後，連續第2年再訪面向東南亞的高口碑展會「2026新加坡科技周」，於本(9)月29日、30日在外貿協會協助下，攜手12家北市科技產業設「台北主題館」，以「Smart Tech.Innovative Taipei」為主軸，對新加坡及東南亞市場展現對AI與智慧解決方案的需求，展現從產業從運算設備、資料治理到終端應用的軟硬整合實力，透過現場洽談及展後追蹤，協助企業拓展國際合作商機。
目前新加坡持續推動「智慧國家2.0」，帶動數位基礎設施、資安防護、企業數位轉型及AI應用需求。依新加坡官方統計，2025年台星商品貿易總額約1,700億星幣(約1,310億美元)，加上台灣為新加坡最大商品貿易夥伴，雙方產業優勢互補，也使新加坡成為台北企業鏈結東南亞市場的重要節點。
此次新加坡科技周整合雲端與AI基礎設施、DevOps、資安、大數據與AI及資料中心等五大專業展，匯聚眾多具影響力的企業技術決策者與具競爭力的解決方案業者。本次臺北主題館依技術鏈與應用需求，將12家企業整合為「智慧運算與感知」、「資料治理與安全」及「智慧應用與服務」三大展示面向，從基礎算力、數據管理延伸至商務服務與人才培訓，呈現台北AI產業的完整解決方案，讓國際買主可快速掌握合作方向。
在「智慧運算與感知」面向，輔信科技與展嘉科技以高算力邊緣運算設備支援即時運算需求；光影立方展出裸眼3D顯示技術；愛比科技與英晟電子整合智慧影音及傳輸系統；皓博科技則以AI設備感知與預測維護方案，協助企業掌握設備狀態及營運風險。
在「資料治理與安全」面向，核桃運算、精誠(6214-TW)資訊及叡揚資訊(6752-TW)分別展出數據平台、資安防禦及雲端碳管理方案；「智慧應用與服務」則由以力科技、優必達及阿特發科技帶來對話式商務平台、互動式虛擬人與XR培訓平台，展現AI技術在企業決策、商務服務及人才培訓等場域的應用潛力。

北市產發局表示，台北具備完整的資通訊研發能量與AI產業鏈，新加坡則是鏈結東南亞市場的重要門戶，雙方在智慧科技與數位轉型領域具高度合作潛力，繼2025年初次參加即促成約2,500萬美元的潛在商機，今年持續拓展耕耘新加坡及東南亞市場，本次參展除展現臺北企業及科技產品的軟硬整合優勢，亦透過強化買主邀約及展後追蹤，協助企業將展會接觸轉化為可持續推進的合作機會，深化與東南亞夥伴的合作關係，共同開拓數位轉型市場契機。
paras_en: The Taipei City Department of Economic Development, after achieving fruitful results at last year’s exhibition, returned for the second consecutive year to the highly regarded Southeast‑Asia‑focused event “2026 Singapore Tech Week.” With the help of the Taiwan External Trade Development Council, twelve Taipei‑based tech firms set up a “Taipei Theme Pavilion” on September 29‑30, centered on “Smart Tech. Innovative Taipei,” to demonstrate the demand for AI and smart solutions in Singapore and the broader Southeast Asian market. The pavilion highlighted end‑to‑end integration from computing hardware and data governance to terminal applications, using on‑site meetings and post‑event follow‑up to help companies expand international partnership opportunities.

Singapore is currently advancing its “Smart Nation 2.0” agenda, driving demand for digital infrastructure, cybersecurity, corporate digital transformation and AI applications. According to official Singapore statistics, total trade in Taiwanese‑Singaporean goods reached about S$170 billion (approximately US$131 billion) in 2025. With Taiwan being Singapore’s largest goods‑trade partner, the complementary strengths of the two economies make Singapore a key node for Taipei firms to connect with the Southeast Asian market.

The Singapore Tech Week this year combined five professional exhibition tracks—cloud and AI infrastructure, DevOps, cybersecurity, big data and AI, and data centers—drawing numerous influential corporate technology decision‑makers and competitive solution providers. The Taipei Theme Pavilion organized the twelve participating companies into three showcase categories—“Intelligent Computing and Sensing,” “Data Governance and Security,” and “Smart Applications and Services”—aligned with technology stacks and application needs. From foundational compute power and data management to business services and talent training, the pavilion presented a complete Taipei AI industry solution suite, enabling international buyers to quickly grasp collaboration opportunities.

In the “Intelligent Computing and Sensing” segment, Fuxin Technology and Zhanjia Technology showcased high‑performance edge‑computing devices for real‑time processing; LightCube displayed naked‑eye 3D display technology; iBii Technology and Yingcheng Electronics integrated smart audio‑visual and transmission systems; and Haobo Technology offered AI‑driven equipment sensing and predictive maintenance solutions to help enterprises monitor asset status and operational risks.

In the “Data Governance and Security” segment, Walnut Computing, Jingcheng Information (6214‑TW) and Ruiyang Information (6752‑TW) exhibited a data platform, cybersecurity defense, and cloud carbon‑management solutions respectively. The “Smart Applications and Services” segment featured Yili Technology, Youbida, and Artifex Technology presenting conversational business platforms, interactive virtual humans, and XR training platforms, demonstrating AI’s potential in corporate decision‑making, business services, and talent development.

items.title: 原料行情續揚惟下游需求仍偏弱 豐興鋼筋盤價止漲轉平
items.title_en: Raw Material Prices Keep Rising but Downstream Demand Remains Weak; Fengxing Rebar Plate Stops Rising and Turns Flat
paras: 鋼筋廠豐興(2015-TW)今(29)日開出本周盤價，雖然廢鋼報價續漲，但因需求仍偏弱，因此本周廢鋼收購價開出平盤，鋼筋也轉為平盤。
國際原料行情來看，美國大船廢鋼本週無報價，日本2H廢鋼本週上漲5美元至每公噸363美元，美國貨櫃廢鋼本週報價上漲4美元至每公噸348美元，澳洲鐵礦砂由每公噸98.2美元下跌至95.85美元。
豐興表示，上週調漲鋼筋後，市場反應溫和，主要因需求仍偏弱，客戶僅採購部分所需，但因]上游原料報價續漲，鋼筋價格易漲難跌，考量實際成交狀況下，故決議本週盤價以平盤開出。
盤價持平下，豐興廢鋼收購價每公噸9800元，鋼筋基每公噸1.83萬元，型鋼基價同樣維持每公噸2.5萬元。
paras_en: Rebar manufacturer Fengxing (2015‑TW) released this week’s price list today (the 29th). Although scrap‑steel prices continued to rise, demand remains weak, so the scrap‑steel purchase price was set flat for the week and rebar also turned flat.

Looking at international raw‑material markets, there was no quote for large U.S. bulk scrap steel this week; Japanese 2H scrap steel rose $5 to $363 per metric ton, U.S. container scrap steel rose $4 to $348 per metric ton, and Australian iron‑ore fines fell from $98.2 to $95.85 per metric ton.

Fengxing said that after raising rebar prices last week, market reaction was moderate, mainly because demand is still weak and customers only purchase part of their needs. However, with upstream raw‑material prices continuing to rise, rebar prices tend to go up rather than down. Considering the actual transaction situation, they decided to set this week’s price list flat.

With the price list flat, Fengxing’s scrap‑steel purchase price is NT$9,800 per metric ton, the base price for rebar is NT$18,300 per metric ton, and the base price for shaped steel remains at NT$25,000 per metric ton.

items.title: 聯準會35歷史上從未在選舉前的10月升息！瑞銀：這次可能也一樣
paras: 美伊衝突推升油價之際，美國公債殖利率同步攀升至近20年高點，市場對聯準會（Fed）10月再度升息的押注也升溫。不過，瑞銀（UBS）認為，市場可能嚴重高估聯準會在美國期中選舉前採取行動的可能性。
根據外媒報導，瑞銀分析師Simon Penn在週一（28日）發布的報告指出，市場目前對10月28日聯準會會議升息的機率定價約69%，存在明顯偏差。
Penn表示，儘管聯準會一再強調貨幣政策決策不受政治活動影響，但在重大政治事件前夕保持克制，仍是歷來常見的做法。
因此，他建議交易員降低對10月升息的押注，並將未來1年累計升息幅度的定價，從目前約91個基點降至75個基點。

35年歷史紀錄：聯準會從未在大選前10月升息

Penn回顧自1990年以來的歷史紀錄發現，過去35年間，僅有3次聯準會在接近11月大選的9月會議升息，分別發生於2004年、2018年及2022年；至於10月會議，則從未出現升息。
其中，2022年升息幅度最大，聯準會單次升息75個基點，是現代史上大選前最大的單次升息幅度，當時聯準會正積極應對疫情後的通膨衝擊。
2004年的升息則屬於當年6月開始的漸進式緊縮周期，並持續至整個選舉季；2018年升息則發生在時任總統川普公開施壓要求聯準會暫停升息的背景下。
Penn認為，若剔除10月升息的市場定價，也不代表投資人應重新押注12月大幅升息50個基點。目前市場對12月會議的累計升息定價約38個基點，他認為應回到完整的25個基點。
從交易角度來看，被移除的10月升息定價應分散至後續會議。Penn預估，明年1月及3月會議的定價將分別增加約12個基點及18個基點。
整體而言，他建議交易員做空長天期債券，並將未來1年累計升息定價由91個基點降至75個基點。

美債殖利率飆升　股票估值承受壓力

另一方面，瑞銀市場分析師Nana Antiedu援引美股策略師Keith Parker的觀點指出，美債殖利率近期急遽攀升，已對股票估值造成明顯壓力，但這也代表，若殖利率回落，市場可能出現較大的反彈空間。
Parker指出，自去年11月以來，隨著10年期美債殖利率今年累計上升約100個基點，標普500指數未來12個月本益比已下滑17%，估值壓縮程度接近衰退情境，也可與1994年升息週期相提並論。
歷史經驗顯示，若利率在沒有大幅緊縮的情況下趨於穩定，也就是年內升息幅度低於100個基點，標普500指數隨後一年通常能取得兩位數報酬；但若進入完整升息週期，亦即年內升息超過100個基點，歷史上的股市報酬往往持平甚至轉為負值。
Parker認為，目前股市對殖利率下滑的反應彈性，大於殖利率進一步上升所帶來的下行風險。他建議投資人為利率維持高檔的環境做好布局，同時留意殖利率回落可能帶來的機會。
在產業配置方面，半導體、製藥、煉油及多元化銀行等次產業獲得較高評價，且對利率的敏感度相對較低。

油價與通膨成市場關鍵變數

目前市場面臨的核心矛盾在於美伊衝突推升能源價格，同時推高通膨及利率壓力。布蘭特原油價格已升至每桶106美元，10年期及30年期美債殖利率則分別攀至2007年及2004年以來最高水準。
市場目前關注的問題是，高能源價格是否會使通膨維持黏著，進而迫使聯準會延長緊縮週期。
本週即將公布的一系列美國經濟數據，將進一步檢驗市場對聯準會政策的預期。若經濟成長數據強勁，可能為聯準會提供更多緊縮空間；若通膨數據高於預期，則可能進一步強化升息理由。
高盛另指出，當10年期美債殖利率在兩週內上升約30個基點，或一個月內上升約50個基點時，股市通常會面臨明顯阻力。
目前10年期美債殖利率自9月9日以來已上升28個基點，自8月21日以來則累計上升37個基點，正接近歷史經驗所顯示的關鍵區間。
市場多頭押注殖利率能在借貸成本進一步侵蝕股市之前趨於穩定；若能源價格見頂、地緣衝突出現緩和跡象，股市可能出現反彈。不過，若能源價格持續高檔，同時經濟數據持續支持聯準會維持緊縮政策，市場面臨的壓力也可能進一步升高。

paras_en: September 30, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center) – U.S. equities closed slightly lower on Tuesday as long‑term Treasury yields kept climbing, with investors awaiting inflation and employment data while weighing the latest remarks from Federal Reserve officials on future rate policy.

The 30‑year Treasury yield rose intraday to 5.6206%, the highest since June 2002; the 10‑year yield peaked at 5.293%, a high not seen since June 2007. As yields retreated from those peaks, the stock market’s losses also narrowed.

New York Fed President John Williams said the Fed still has time to watch the data before deciding when to raise rates further. According to CME FedWatch, the market’s probability of a 25‑basis‑point hike in October fell to 51.5%, down from near 70% earlier in the session.

Rising crude oil and diesel prices have revived inflation concerns and pushed Treasury yields higher. The Fed has already lifted rates by 25 basis points this month, and several officials warned that if inflation pressure does not continue to ease, additional hikes may still be needed.
Market attention now shifts to Wednesday’s Personal Consumption Expenditures (PCE) price index and Friday’s non‑farm payroll report, both of which will shape expectations for the Fed’s policy path.

The Dow Jones Industrial Average fell 131.59 points, or 0.26%, to 51,349.92; the S&P 500 slipped 12.85 points, or 0.17%, to 7,670.84; the Nasdaq Composite dropped 22.84 points, or 0.08%, to 26,797.54.

The Labor Department’s Job Openings and Labor Turnover Survey (JOLTS) showed August job openings fell by 256,000 to 7.08 million, below the market estimate of 7.225 million, indicating a cooling of labor demand.

The Conference Board’s September consumer confidence index fell to its lowest level in nearly 12½ years, with households becoming more pessimistic about business conditions and the labor market over the next six months.

Fed officials remain divided on future policy. Williams advocates waiting for more data, Fed Governor Michael Barr says further hikes may still be required, and Chicago Fed President Austan Goolsbee warns that allowing inflation to stay above the Fed’s target for too long raises policy risk.
In AI stocks, Anthropic’s IPO prospectus shows the company’s operations grew rapidly over the past year but losses expanded as well, and it is now seeking a valuation of over $2 trillion.

Meta Platforms (META-US) rose 3.3% after OpenAI unveiled “dots,” a resident AI agent that can autonomously perform tasks across applications, which the market sees as potential competition to Meta’s newly launched Muse.

Among individual stocks, used‑car retailer CarMax (KMX-US) jumped 4.7% after reporting second‑quarter profit and revenue growth, while credit‑scoring firm Fair Isaac (FICO-US) plunged 26.5% after the Federal Housing Finance Agency said Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac will adopt a single‑price framework.
Market breadth was weak, with the New York Stock Exchange showing a down‑to‑up ratio of 1.66 to 1, and the Nasdaq a ratio of 1.47 to 1.
